headline: LIL' KIM TAKES HARD CORE TO THE SYMPHONY
caption:
Lil' Kim will celebrate the 30th anniversary of Hard Core with a one-night orchestral performance at Brooklyn's Kings Theatre on November 19. Hard Core Symphony pairs Kim with Thee Phantom & The Illharmonic Orchestra for newly arranged versions of songs from her landmark debut.

Source: Lil' Kim official announcement
